mcqs.question: Under the ‘Super GST – Super Savings’ programme in Andhra Pradesh, what was the GST rate on key fisheries items reduced to?
mcqs.explanation: The GST rate on key fisheries items was reduced from 12% to 5%. The figures of ₹1.50 per unit and ₹20,000 per acre relate to the power subsidy for aqua farmers, while 12% was the earlier GST rate.
